about_the_game:
Pineapple Legend

 Visual Novel

  • Find the Golden Pineapple in 5 surprising chapters

  • Investigate among 20 different cases

  • Solve a dozen puzzles

  • Collect over 200 cards

  • Explore the city of Takitani

  • Catch around sixty fish

  • Garden in your own backyard

  • Equip a variety of accessories and gear

  • Eat food (sometimes weird...)

  • Increase your affinity with other characters through dialogue, gifts, and quests

  • Level up to progress in your adventures

  • Face enemies in the Colosseum

  • Customize your own character

  • Take part in various mini-games

  • Unlock over 100 achievements

----

An Incredible Story:

Story:

During the 500th anniversary of the Golden Pineapple, a grand ceremony was held to celebrate the event. However, amidst the festivities, a power outage suddenly plunged the venue into darkness. When the lights returned, the pineapple had vanished from its pedestal.

Dark clouds began to gather over the city, the rain poured down in a torrential downpour, and violent gusts of wind howled through the streets. Thunder rumbled, illuminating the sky with blinding flashes, each accompanied by an eerie, deafening roar.

After several long hours, the storm finally subsided. But as the frightened citizens stepped out into the drenched streets, their fear only grew—a Mayan corpse lay juxtaposed at the center of the town hall.

The police quickly assembled, joined by the BAD (Bureau of Advanced Detection). Ophélie and Sacha began their search for a skilled investigator to uncover the truth behind this bizarre event.

And now, the fate of this mystery rests in your hands!

So, will you be able to…

Find the Golden Pineapple?

---

Surprisingly Hilarious Investigations:

Take part in bizarre and twisted cases (Yogurt Poisoning, The Spoon Murderer, The French Fry Gun, or The Resurrection of the Toilet Paper Mummy…)

Explore the four branching paths of each investigation, where choices will alter both the case and its culprit.

Collect clues in your investigation journal.

Experience twenty thrilling and outrageous cases!

Customize Your Character and Make Them UNIQUE!

  • Choose your identity.

  • Change your character’s skin color.

  • Pick your hair color.

  • Modify outfits or their colors.

  • Equip accessories like police badges.

Your character will look just how you want, but their posture and hairstyles will remain the same throughout the game.

---

Solve Mysterious Puzzles!

---

Catch a Multitude of Fish!

----

Collect Tons of Cards!

Unlock a Multitude of Achievements!

Conclusion:

Pineapple Legend is primarily a detective game, designed to be accessible to all players—even those who don’t necessarily enjoy visual novels.

The freedom offered by Pineapple Legend allows players to enjoy various different experiences, all while preserving the core visual novel essence!

The game features rich and humorous gameplay, and as Ophélie would say:
"Ze crois que on va z'amuzer!"

Meanwhile, Sacha is far too busy tending to his glorious hair… Unbelievable, these two goofballs… Thankfully, your character is here to make up for their shortcomings!

Even though, perhaps, it’s finally time to… recover the Golden Pineapple…

So, what are you waiting for, detective?

We wish you a fantastic adventure.

May the stars align in your favor! ✨

content_descriptors.notes: Contains violent acts and sordid humor. Some dialogue may appear violent and, on rare occasions, sexual—primarily for humorous purposes. There are no scenes of nudity. Dark humor and jokes involving children are present. The game remains accessible to most of the public.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ Core i3 8350k or AMD Ryzen3 3200G
  • Graphics: Intel® UHD Graphics 630 or Radeon™ Vega 8 Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10 (64-BIT Required)/WINDOWS® 11 (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-9100F or AMD Ryzen3 3200G
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GT 1030 (VRAM2GB) or AMD Radeon™ RX550(VRAM2GB)
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

short_description: Find the Golden Pineapple and the crimes against the Mayans. In Pineapple Legend, solve investigations with amusing and humorous situations. Explore the city of Takitani: investigate, solve puzzles, collect cards, equip accessories, fish, garden, fight in the arena, and increase your affinity!!!
